subject: Re: Quick sync to map your inference footprint + demo slot
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam@orchardhealth.ai>
To: hello@redwoodinference.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Redwood Inference — demo & infra questions

Hi Redwood team (cc: Tessa),

We signed up via the self-serve flow and are interested in a short product demo to see how Redwood would fit into our inference stack. High level: we run clinical-document summarization + semantic search over patient notes and want to move from a batch setup to lower-latency online inference.

A few quick questions to help scope the demo:
- Typical models we use: Llama-2 style open models and a couple of smaller fine-tuned checkpoints.
- Expected volume: ballpark 50–150M tokens per month (varies by cohort) — currently mostly batch.
- Target latency: ideally <200ms p95 for summarization snippets, but we can pilot with relaxed SLOs.
- Timeline: hoping for a pilot in Q3 (Aug timeframe).

Could we book a 30-min slot next week? Mornings PST are easiest for our CTO.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Patel
Director of ML Platforms, Orchard Health

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@orchardhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood Inference — demo & infra questions

Hi Sam — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for signing up. I'm Tessa on the SDR/BDR team — looping in Marissa (AE) so she can join the call. Quick follow-ups so we make the demo action-oriented: 

1) Model surface: are the checkpoints you mentioned public (Llama-style) or privately fine-tuned weights that we should treat as customer-hosted?
2) Volume: can you confirm whether the 50–150M tokens estimate is steady-state or includes anticipated ramp during pilot? A rough daily qps/requests-per-minute number is helpful.
3) Latency SLO: you wrote ~200ms p95 — is that strict for the pilot or would you be comfortable with 300–400ms during initial rollout?
4) Pilot goals: what are the success criteria for an August pilot (e.g., latency, cost per request, throughput)?

Available 30-min slots (PST) next week:
- Tue 29 Jun 10:00–10:30
- Tue 29 Jun 11:30–12:00
- Wed 30 Jun 09:00–09:30

Or grab a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood/tessa-30m
Attached is a short intake form that helps our SE prep (intake_form.pdf). If you could reply with answers to the bullets above and a preferred slot, I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Cheers,

Tessa Morgan
SDR, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0123
Attachments: intake_form.pdf (1 page: intake questions)
From: Sam Patel <sam@orchardhealth.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood Inference — demo & infra questions

Hi Tessa (and Marissa),

Thanks — answers inline below. I'll take Tue 29 Jun 10:00 PT if that works for you.

1) Models: mostly public open models with a couple of lightly fine-tuned checkpoints we host internally (not customer-only locked). We expect to want both hosted and private deployment patterns in the long run.
2) Volume: 50–150M is steady-state once we onboard two cohorts. Pilot will be smaller — expect ~5–10M tokens during a 2–4 week pilot. Typical burst: ~200 concurrent requests peak across our service during business hours (~late-morning PT).
3) Latency SLO: pilot can accept 300–350ms p95. For production we want to approach ~150–200ms p95.
4) Pilot goals: (a) validate 3x reduction in cost per 1k tokens vs current infra, (b) achieve <=350ms p95 in pilot, (c) confirm rolling deploys with canary fallback.

Preferred slot: Tue 29 Jun 10:00 PT — please send invite.
Stakeholders: Me (Director ML), Priya Kapoor (CTO) <priya.k@orchardhealth.ai>, and one of our ML infra engineers (I'll add them to the invite).

Thanks — attaching a quick environment note we promised to share on the call.

Best,
Sam
Director of ML Platforms, Orchard Health
